reuse.why: It wraps the existing assertAccountNotLinked for the refusal path, but repeats that function's holder query for the take-over path and copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: prepareAccountLink copies the holder lookup SQL from assertAccountNotLinked and the eight-field unlink update from unlinkAccount in app.ts.

placement.why: The take-over logic sits in accounts/link.ts beside the other link guards, though it writes account fields that unlinkAccount in app.ts owns.

scope.why: Only the flag threading through the six link handlers, the new guard and one test.

maintainability.why: Two copies of 'who holds this bank account' and two copies of 'what unlinking clears' will have to be kept in step by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts prepareAccountLink re-implements the local unlink from unlinkAccount (app.ts) with its own db.updateAccount instead of a shared unlink helper.

disguised_duplication.where: Both copies are verbatim (same SQL, same field list), not reshaped.
